purpose: Apply or reverse one bounded inventory reservation in a tenant-scoped ledger.
consequence: A successful reserve operation reduces immediately available inventory and creates a durable reservation entry until a release operation reverses it.

state_contract.items: per-tenant object keyed by item_id with non-negative integer available and reserved fields
state_contract.reservations: object keyed by action_id with tenant_id, item_id, quantity, request_id, and status
state_contract.request_history: object keyed by request_id containing the exact accepted request and resulting action_id

formats.actor_principal_id: ASCII identifier matching ^principal-[a-z0-9-]+$; recorded for later independent authorization evaluation but not used by the factual transition rule

reserve: request conforms to the reserve request contract
quantity is no greater than item.available
request_id is unused, unless the request is an exact replay of an accepted request
release: request conforms to the release request contract
action_id names an applied reservation in the same tenant
request_id is unused, unless the request is an exact replay of an accepted request

new_reserve: derive action_id as act- followed by the suffix of request_id after req-
record the exact request and action_id in request_history
return status applied and the derived action_id
new_release: add the referenced reservation quantity to item.available
set the reservation status to released
record the exact request and referenced action_id in request_history
return status released and the referenced action_id
exact_replay: return status idempotent_replay and the previously recorded action_id
failed_precondition: return status rejected with exactly one error_code

post_state_success_rule: The action result and complete resulting state must exactly equal the state produced by these factual transition rules. Actor identity is carried through for separate authorization evaluation and does not change factual action success.
reversibility_rule: A successful release of an applied reservation restores the affected item's available and reserved quantities to their values immediately before the corresponding reserve, except for other independently applied actions. The reservation and request-history audit records remain, with reservation status released.
